result_summary: WP804 compatible-goal preservation plus existing Hyperposition/EAS remains the preferred reuse path, but compatible goal identity alone is causally insufficient to derive expected information gain. A minimal typed score-derivation binding must bind state, legal probes, outcome/likelihood model, explicit scoring/prior policy and derived score. Uniform-compatible-set EIG may be a policy mode but must never be an implicit prior or world fact.
next_exact_gate: Falsify exact state/model/policy digest binding and score reproducibility before E5 build-candidate promotion.
